topics.label: Welcome and Lecture Framing
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic introduces the lecture series, outlines the learning objectives, and frames the discussion on cancer evolution and the microenvironment.

topics.label: Genetic and Epigenetic Mechanisms of Clonal Evolution
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how sequential driver mutations, competitive clonal selection, and epigenetic alterations collectively drive the acquisition of cancer hallmarks.

topics.label: Cell of Origin and Cancer Stem Cell Hierarchies
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore the cancer stem cell model and investigate how tissue hierarchies and normal stem cell properties influence tumor initiation across different cancer types.

topics.label: Microenvironmental and Inflammatory Promotion of Tumorigenesis
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics demonstrate how external environmental exposures and local chronic inflammation act as promotional cues to activate stem-like states and drive malignant transformation in mutated cells.

topics.label: Established Tumor Microenvironment, Profiling Technologies, and Evolutionary Synthesis
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine the stromal dependency of established tumors, outline modern spatial profiling methodologies, and synthesize the multi-factorial coevolutionary model of cancer development.

topics.label: Closing Remarks and Next Lecture
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic concludes the lecture and provides housekeeping details regarding the upcoming session on cancer therapy.
